'''Skinwalker''' was a destination on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].

==Behind the scenes==
The name was inserted onto the subtram map as an in-joke by the production team, along with the other destinations on the map.
